name: Nutrient gate
oneLine: A protein door in the membrane that lets food in.
howItWorks: The membrane blocks most food molecules. Gate proteins span it and pass specific molecules across. More gates, more food.
deeper: Many gates spend energy to pull food in against the flow. The minimal cell relies on its gates because it cannot make many nutrients itself.
sizeComparison: a 10,000th the width of a hair
simplification: One gate type stands in for dozens of real ones.
